name: @tiledev/sdk-shopify
description: Type-safe Shopify Storefront API client for React Native (web, iOS, Android). Products, collections, cart, customer session, blogs, a local-storage-backed wishlist, and configurable shopper alerts. Zero deps beyond fetch.
